question_en: Take one measurement at 5% power and 1 second exposure, and compute the area of the 900-1100 cm-1 region by trapezoid integration.
answer: requires: calibrated == True. One file set; cited number == the integral recomputed from the saved CSV (1e-6).
setup: Required: calibrator connected (calibrated == True). On the instrument axis 900-1100 cm-1 has 76 points, so the trapezoidal integral is stable.
gt_kind: Self-consistency: there is no pre-determined GT. The grading code recomputes the value from the files the agent acquired and compares it with the reported value. This is why the answer is determined without knowing the sample.
